payload.title: Scanner adapters emit canonical observations
payload.description:
Scanner adapter emits canonical observations for components, data flows and the personal-data projections.

Replaces `componentIdentity` (`${type}:${name.toLowerCase()}`) and `dataFlowIdentity` (`flow:${componentKey}->${componentKey}`) with structured fields. The taxonomy becomes an output vocabulary: nothing in `src/` currently reads `patterns/component-taxonomy.yaml` — the only consumer is `tests/unit/taxonomy.spec.ts`, a test-time containment check — so the engine has never been taught the vocabulary its gold is written in.

Blocked on the component instance ruling, which decides whether `component.name` populates the instance field for assets.
